eyebrow: A few instances at a time
code:
Start:  [old][old][old][old]   all old
Step 1: [new][old][old][old]   1 replaced
Step 2: [new][new][old][old]   2 replaced
Step 3: [new][new][new][old]   3 replaced
Step 4: [new][new][new][new]   done
caption: No second full environment -- the running service is replaced gradually, in place.

code:
Max surge:
  extra instances allowed above normal count

Max unavailable:
  instances allowed to be DOWN at once

Conservative: unavailable=0, small surge -> slow, safe
caption: Zero max unavailable means capacity never drops during the rollout.

code:
During rollout, at the SAME moment:
  Request A -> old instance -> old checkpoint's answer
  Request B -> new instance -> new checkpoint's answer

Same question, asked twice, two different
(both "correct") answers.
caption: Fine for one-off completions -- a real problem for anything expecting session consistency.
